name: Draft and validate a LaunchAgent plist in /tmp (not installed)

data.command: printf '%s\n' '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>' '<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">' '<plist version="1.0"><dict><key>Label</key><string>com.intentframe.notify</string><key>ProgramArguments</key><array><string>/bin/echo</string><string>IntentFrame active</string></array><key>RunAtLoad</key><false/></dict></plist>' > /tmp/com.intentframe.notify.plist && plutil -lint /tmp/com.intentframe.notify.plist && echo 'LaunchAgent draft validated in /tmp; not installed'

submissions.reason: Scaffold a user LaunchAgent plist with shell-only ProgramArguments (/bin/echo), validate with plutil, and keep it under /tmp only — no ~/Library/LaunchAgents write and no AppleScript launcher.

cleanup.reason: Remove the draft LaunchAgent plist from /tmp.
